newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Kumagai, PNCC vie for transport project.
newsitem.headline: Kumagai, PNCC vie for transport project.

text.p: Kumagai Gumi Co Ltd (KG) of Japan, Bechtel Overseas Corp of the U.S., and the Philippine National Construction Corp (PNCC) said on Tuesday they would submit a joint bid for a 14-km mass rail transit project.

PNCC president Rogelio Luis told the Philippine Stock Exchange that the three had signed an "agreement to associate," paving the way for the group to submit prequalification documents to the state-run Light Rail Transit Authority for the project.
Transport officials have said the project, the Metro Manila Strategic Mass Rail Transit Development (Line 2), will cost 26 billion pesos.
Kumagai will take the lead in the project, but the three companies will take equal shares in the consortium.
